name: echo_then_reply_same_turn
description: Muse keeps one turn open while the steer's echo (59.4 s) runs straight into seat 2's answer: the partials are the line, then the reply, until 78 s. Once three words the line never said arrive the turn is a person's, so no crumb fires while they talk, nothing barges in, and the turn is not dropped as bot speech. Before the fix the whole answer was treated as echo and a switch fired over it at 76.9 s.
crumb_text: So what is something you both love doing on the weekends?

turns.text: So I just got back from a climbing trip in Colorado last weekend.
No way, I have always wanted to go climbing out there. Which area?
We were near Boulder, mostly the Flatirons, which honestly have the best views ever.
That sounds amazing, I mostly climb indoors at the gym near campus right now.
Indoor is great for training though, do you boulder or do top rope routes?
Mostly bouldering, my friends dragged me there freshman year and I got hooked.
Same thing happened to me with running, a friend signed me up for a race.
Did you end up liking it or was it pure suffering the whole time?
Honestly both, but now I am training for my first half marathon in March.
That is so cool, what does your training look like on a normal week?

turns.label: B
turns.text: So what is something you both love doing on the weekends? Oh that is easy, we both love going to the farmers market on Saturday mornings and then cooking a huge brunch together with whatever we found there. It started as a once a month thing during sophomore year, and now we basically plan the whole week around it, which sounds a little silly, but it is honestly the best part of the weekend for both of us and our roommates keep asking to come along
